rows.actual: Can the actual R-141/R-142 complete trace-current terminal feature be placed in one canonical common-terminal tower without importing old root owners?
rows.name: EXP-000615 question

rows.actual: The actual signed terminal feature has a unique fixed-cutoff canonical Doob tower, and its relative terminal form is exactly the base cross plus all signed reveal brackets. The R-141 three-feature signature compresses to the R-142 two-feature signature at every reveal and increment.
rows.name: EXP-000615 finding

rows.actual: This constructs a new aggregate terminal-feature coordinate. It does not establish equality with the registered R-063/R-104/R-125 root, forest, future, or low owners.
rows.name: EXP-000615 boundary

rows.actual: Test the proposed production owner rows against the one-step tower, registered incidence, and predictable trace-bracket matching conditions.
rows.name: EXP-000615 next_action

rows.actual: Does the common-terminal signed form admit exact conditional and continuous-time recursions without a positivity assumption?
rows.name: EXP-000616 question

rows.actual: The signed future remainder obeys an exact backward conditional recursion, and the expected terminal cross is the base cross plus the time integral of the signed Hilbert-Schmidt bracket. Neither identity has a sign because the signature is indefinite.
rows.name: EXP-000616 finding

rows.actual: The continuous formula requires the completed right-continuous canonical Brownian filtration to have the martingale-representation property. Clark-Ocone is not asserted for a merely L2 terminal.
rows.name: EXP-000616 boundary

rows.actual: Use the exact signed recursion only after matching the actual production row and never as an automatic positivity theorem.
rows.name: EXP-000616 next_action

rows.actual: Does equality of terminal Gaussian law or covariance transport the old reveal owners into the canonical covariance chart?
rows.name: EXP-000617 question

rows.actual: Equal terminal laws have different sequential energy allocations, and equal terminal covariance paths can have incompatible prefix spectra under every time change. Representation-universal transport therefore requires the whole projection nest and physical synthesis to intertwine.
rows.name: EXP-000617 finding

rows.actual: The no-go rejects endpoint-law-only or representation-universal transport. It does not rule out accidental equality for one actual terminal on its cyclic tower subspace, which must be checked directly.
rows.name: EXP-000617 boundary

rows.actual: Apply the one-step tower criterion to each proposed actual production row instead of transferring legacy owner labels.
rows.name: EXP-000617 next_action

rows.actual: Under the full registered R-125/R-063 incidence, what exact defect remains between the primitive production trace and a canonical Doob increment bracket?
rows.name: EXP-000618 question

rows.actual: With bar_tau=E[tau|F_(o-)] and beta the conditional Doob bracket, the exact conditioned residual is E[r|F_(o-)]=bar_tau-beta-<b_p,b_q>. Equality to the specific defect-free predictable mean Gram is equivalent to bar_tau=beta.
rows.name: EXP-000618 finding

rows.actual: This identity also requires common heat, once-owned covariance, same-root recombination, exhaustive output or explicit leakage, and actual identification with the registered adapted R-063 forest. Production matching is not proved.
rows.name: EXP-000618 boundary

rows.actual: Compute bar_tau-beta for the full owner-complete active-spectator production direction and retain every companion once.
rows.name: EXP-000618 next_action

rows.actual: Can the adapted R-063 forest be identified with a PSD quadratic variation or Gaussian Poincare subbracket?
rows.name: EXP-000619 question

rows.actual: The registered forest is a signed same-regulator Wick-Taylor reconstruction with lower contractions and no registered PSD subbracket representation. Gaussian Poincare cannot replace it.
rows.name: EXP-000619 finding

rows.actual: The result rejects the forest-as-bracket shortcut; it does not prove that the complete forest/future/low aggregate is adverse.
rows.name: EXP-000619 boundary

rows.actual: Retain the adapted forest literally and test its exact recombination with the predictable trace-bracket defect.
rows.name: EXP-000619 next_action

rows.actual: Does centering the current inside one common-terminal tower make the scalar trace-current defect nonpositive?
rows.name: EXP-000620 question

rows.actual: For every t>0 the exact defect is 2t/(1+2t)^(3/2)>0, although the current is centred, and its ratio to the trace square tends to one.
rows.name: EXP-000620 finding

rows.actual: This is an abstract same-root method counterfixture, not a counterexample to the complete production action or any phase.
rows.name: EXP-000620 boundary

rows.actual: Keep the production coefficient with its forest, future, balanced, low, and sextic companions in one signed owner.
rows.name: EXP-000620 next_action

rows.actual: Does the actual A1/R-075 Pauli coefficient have a production-specific signed class even though the generic same-root sign fails?
rows.name: EXP-000621 question

rows.actual: The retained P+L energy has uniform collinear curvature at least 2223/(25000P). Every predictable affine collinear Gaussian line has defect at most -2223 sigma^4/(25000P). At zero background, the P and L rows contribute at most -12/(125P) and -6/(125P).
rows.name: EXP-000621 finding

rows.actual: This is a production-coefficient collinear slice. It excludes non-collinear directions, multiple roots, active wedge rows, spatial projections, and the complete forest/future/low owner.
rows.name: EXP-000621 boundary

rows.actual: Evaluate the full companion owner on the exact active-spectator direction before attempting a global production bound.
rows.name: EXP-000621 next_action

rows.actual: Can the affine-collinear P+L theorem be globalized to all internal directions by coefficient convexity?
rows.name: EXP-000622 question

rows.actual: The exact curvature is 3(-528R^4-88R^2e+113e^2)/(1000P(2R^2+e)^2) and is negative above R^2/e=-1/12+5sqrt(154)/132. Thus the retained pair is not globally convex.
rows.name: EXP-000622 finding

rows.actual: The fixture omits the adapted forest, future variance, balanced cross, returned low, spatial owners, and terminal sextic. It refutes only a convexity-only closure of the retained coefficient pair.
rows.name: EXP-000622 boundary

rows.actual: Compute the owner-complete legal active-spectator scaling and compare the aggregate with eta<5/11 and zeta<13/50.
rows.name: EXP-000622 next_action
